ctx.x: You were telling me about the outstanding bands of years ago for planned funerals.

You know, well, the best bands in life. It was the Excelsior, Arnold Brass Band, Torsita, original Torsita. I don't mean John and them young Torsita. I mean the original Torsita. Then there was the Ux Sand. And of course, Alan, he had a band of old and out there. He was pretty good, but highly average. He didn't have no way of, he said, the men managed to play with him. The way he'd do, if he'd get a job, he'd come and get me. If I'm a good man, if he's a good man, get him, I'd play him good. And other fellows…
Well, about how far back did those bands go? Were they already playing when you came to New Orleans?
